variants.title: Count work in flight
variants.context: Concurrency is the average number of requests inside a system. In a stable system, it equals completed requests per second multiplied by average end-to-end seconds.
variants.prompt: A stable service completes 200 requests/second. Mean time in the system is 0.25 seconds. How many requests are in flight on average?
variants.hint: Multiply throughput by average time in seconds.
variants.explanation: 200 × 0.25 = 50.0. Convert milliseconds to seconds before multiplying.

variants.title: Add a sequential path
variants.context: Sequential stages run one after another. Their elapsed times add when there is no overlap.
variants.prompt: A request spends 20 ms in the network, 30 ms in the service, and 50 ms in storage. The stages are sequential. What is total latency?
variants.explanation: 20 + 30 + 50 = 100 ms. More concurrent requests do not shorten this single path.
